name: maestro-practice
description: Maestro UI tests for the Wikipedia Android app

scripts.reset:app: echo '[reset:app] 앱 데이터 초기화 (org.wikipedia)' && adb shell pm clear org.wikipedia
scripts.test:sanity: npm run -s reset:app && mkdir -p report && maestro test flows --include-tags=sanity --format=junit --output=report/sanity.xml --test-suite-name=sanity
scripts.test:regression: npm run -s reset:app && mkdir -p report && maestro test flows --include-tags=regression --format=junit --output=report/regression.xml --test-suite-name=regression
scripts.test:tag: npm run -s reset:app && maestro test flows --config config/tag-run.yaml --include-tags
